text:
Maya: quick sync — Edge Prefetch launch: need to lock dependencies and launch gates for this quarter. who can confirm infra and runtime slots?
Sam: we have a rough eng roadmap but need runtime batching config before we can commit ETA. Lin?
Lin (Runtime): can do perf profiles next week. want to validate continuous batching + prefix cache for hot tenants.
Noor (Infra): capacity wise we can reserve two dedicated pools for the pilot, but need exact GPU/slot counts. estimates?
Sam: starting load assumptions: 50 rps peak for pilot, 10k tokens/s aggregate. might be fine with 2xA10 equiv.
Lin (Runtime): sounds ok, but batching params matter — if latency SLO is 150ms p95 we should cap batch window to 8ms. otherwise need 4x GPUs.
Maya: important: Customer A requires private deployment SLA. that affects rollout order and security review. Dave can you own compliance checklist?
Dave (Security): yes. I'll run a quick threat model and KMS integration check. need input on data flows and retention.
Maya: tagging for dependencies: 1) runtime perf knobs, 2) infra capacity reservation, 3) security HSM/KMS sign-off, 4) prewarm/observability hooks (SRE).
Ryan (SRE): observability — we'll need token-level cost traces and a per-model latency dashboard. can instrument if runtime emits per-request trace. Lin, can runtime emit minimal traces?
Lin (Runtime): yes, can emit trace id + model_version + batch_size + latency. will add a flag to enable structured traces.
Noor (Infra): on prewarm we want a controlled prewarm service rather than always-on workers. can we do staggered prewarm windows per-tenant?
Sam: yes, plan is tenant-aware prewarm with idle eviction. tie to reserved capacity.
Maya: decision needed: Do we gate pilot on security sign-off or on infra prewarm readiness? we should pick an order to minimize rework.
Dave (Security): security sign-off typically needs final topology + KMS config. that's only stable once infra and runtime configs are firm. recommend gate = infra + runtime config stable, then security review.
Noor (Infra): agree. we can provision staging clusters earlier for security to validate, even if final sizing changes.
Maya: ok gate sequence: 1) runtime perf profile + config (Lin) -> 2) infra staging provision + capacity reservation (Noor) -> 3) security review + KMS check (Dave) -> 4) SRE observability hooks + canary (Ryan).
Sam: timeline ask: Lin perf profile by Tue EOD (next week), Noor reserve staging by Thu, Dave will start review Fri, Ryan will prepare dashboards over the week. realistic?
Lin (Runtime): I can run perf matrix Mon-Tue. will post results and a recommended batch_window/batch_max_size.
Noor (Infra): I'll allocate staging clusters Wed-Thu and share inventory. will tag reserved pools for the pilot.
Dave (Security): I'll start threat model once infra inventory is up. target review complete next Fri.
Ryan (SRE): I'll stub dashboards and alerting rules. need the trace schema from Lin — can you paste sample?
Lin (Runtime): sample trace schema:```
trace_id: string
model_version: string
batch_size: int
latency_ms: int
tenant_id?: string
```)
Ryan (SRE): perfect, will wire that into dataplane.
Maya: rollout plan sketch (short): canary 10% traffic -> 30% -> 100% over 3 days with automatic rollback on p95 > 200ms or error_rate > 0.5%. product approves customer pilot at 10% w/ manual go.
Sam: note: canary needs fallback model variant that is cheaper/higher-latency to avoid outage. Lin can we expose fallback knob?
Lin (Runtime): yes, runtime can route to fallback variant on runbook signal. will add a route flag.
Noor (Infra): we should also have cross-region fallback if a region's capacity is saturated. routing policy config needed.
Maya: action items (owners):
- Lin: perf profiles + trace schema (due: +7d)
- Noor: staging clusters + reserve pools (due: +9d)
- Dave: security threat model + KMS checklist (due: +14d)
- Ryan: dashboards + canary alerting (due: +10d)
- Sam: fallback variant + rollout playbook (due: +11d)
- Maya: coordinate customer pilot window and sign-off (due: +12d)
Sam: can we put those in a small PRD and a trello/board ticket? I'll create the PRD and link infra/runbook tickets.
Maya: yes please create PRD and tag @Noor @Lin @Dave @Ryan. cc: deploy-bot when infra reservation done.
deploy-bot: infra: staging cluster allocation succeeded (staging-cluster-efx). inventory: 2xA10 equiv reserved (noor@example.com). :white_check_mark:
Noor (Infra): allocating final pools now. will drop inventory link in thread.
Maya: thanks. one last ask: engineering budget check — reserving 2 GPUs affects other pilots. finance ok? Sam will loop in finance if we need more.
Sam: I'll ping finance now.
Maya: great. let's reconvene after Lin posts perf numbers. short standup Wed at 10am to review blockers. :thumbsup:
